summary: Nebius Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, reporting results of its Annual General Meeting held the prior day. All resolutions proposed, including adoption of 2025 accounts, director reappointments, auditor appointment, and share issuance authorization, were adopted by shareholders voting as a single class. Class A and B shares outstanding totaled 271,857,596 with 572,953,093 voting rights. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure; no special-situation transaction or event is indicated.
